name: Airtable
description: Productivity/project management: spreadsheet-database hybrid app platform with a Web API for records, bases, schema and webhooks.
access_notes: Free plan available; personal access tokens are created self-serve at airtable.com/create/tokens (all plan types) and OAuth integrations are registered self-serve at airtable.com/create/oauth. Legacy API keys are no longer supported.
mcp_notes: Official hosted Airtable MCP server at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp (OAuth or PAT auth; can read/write records and even build interfaces and automations), documented at support.airtable.com and airtable.com articles. Composio AIRTABLE toolkit exists (26 tools, 6 triggers, OAUTH2/API_KEY, Composio managed auth).
uncertainty_notes: Webhooks created with PAT/OAuth tokens expire after 7 days unless refreshed. Org admins can restrict third-party integrations (MCP may need admin allowlisting in managed enterprises), but default developer access is self-serve.

evidence.note: Token-based auth via Authorization: Bearer; personal access tokens (created at /create/tokens) for personal use and OAuth access tokens (integrations registered at /create/oauth) for third-party integrations; legacy api_key not supported.
OAuth grant flow documented for integrations acting on behalf of other users; 'Any integrations that allow other users to grant access to Airtable should use OAuth.'
Official Webhooks API: create/list/delete webhooks per base, notification pings to a URL, webhook:manage scope; available on all billing plans.
Official Airtable MCP server at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp with OAuth browser auth or personal access token.
Composio toolkit catalog lists Airtable (slug AIRTABLE, 26 tools, 6 triggers, OAUTH2/API_KEY, Composio managed app: Yes).
